title: Counter configuration components
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes on input $x$, let $q$ be an optional counter-loop state, and let $ct:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and $cp\in\mathbb{Z}$. The configuration with $k+1$ work tapes formed by adjoining $ct$ as the last tape, placing its head at $cp$, and setting the state to $q$ has the same input-head position and output as $c$, and its first $k$ work tapes and head positions are those of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $k\in\mathbb{N}$; $S$ is a type; $x$ is a Boolean word
